book.title: The Art of Computer Programming, Volume 1: Fundamental Algorithms
book.author: Donald E. Knuth

predict.question: Your family phone tree starts with you, and each person calls two new people. After two rounds of calls, how many people are in the full tree, counting you?

exploreHint: Compare both named cases and inspect what changes.
bookIdea: Tree analysis requires counting all relevant nodes in the data structure.
modelBoundary: The unary path contains {A}; the binary tree contains {B}. The final layer is only part of each total because earlier nodes remain.
doesItHoldUp: Does it hold up? This is a full collision-free tree, not a search with incomplete branches or reused states.
